FAQ

## Room design FAQ

### Is iRoomDesign free?

You can try it free. New accounts get 1 free room design — no credit card, no watermark. After that, packs start at $4.99 for 22 designs. If a generation fails, your credits are refunded automatically.

### Do I need to sign up?

Yes, a free account is needed so we can save your designs to My Designs and give you your free room design. Sign-up takes a few seconds with Google or email.

### Do I need to download an app?

No. iRoomDesign works in the browser on your phone or computer. Open the site, upload a photo and pick a style.

### Is this a 3D room planner?

No. Instead of drawing a floor plan and dragging furniture around in 3D, you upload a photo of your real room and AI shows you a realistic redesign of that exact space in about a minute.

### Will it keep my walls, windows and room size?

Yes. iRoomDesign keeps your room's layout, windows, doors, ceiling height and proportions, so the design matches your real space. It's a concept image for inspiration, not a measured construction drawing.

### Can I keep my walls and floors and just change the furniture?

Yes. Choose "Just new furniture" and your walls, floors and ceiling stay as they are — only the furniture and decor change. Choose "Renovate everything" for a full makeover of an empty or old room.

### Can I use an inspiration photo instead of a style?

Yes. Tap "Use my own photo" as your style and upload a room you love, for example from Pinterest. The AI follows its colors, materials and mood while keeping your own room's structure. It costs the same 3 credits.

### Which rooms can I design?

Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dining rooms, home offices and bathrooms. Kitchens and bathrooms keep their real size and a practical layout.

### What kind of photo works best?

Stand in a corner or doorway and shoot towards the opposite corner, so two or three walls, the floor and the windows are in frame. Hold your phone horizontally at chest height, use the 0.5× wide lens for small rooms (like bathrooms and kitchens), and shoot in daylight with the lights on. One room per photo.

### Can I use it for virtual staging, listings or client presentations?

Yes. The designs you create are yours to use in property listings, client presentations and social posts. For virtual staging, upload an empty or dated room and choose "Renovate everything". They are AI concept images for inspiration, not construction drawings — mark them as virtually staged where your local rules require it.

### What happens to my photos?

Your photos are only used to create your designs. They are sent to our AI image provider to generate the design, never sold and never used by us to train AI models, and they are not shown publicly unless you share a design yourself. Uploaded photos are deleted automatically after 15 days and generated designs after 90 days. You can delete any design from My Designs, or your whole account in Settings, at any time.
